targets.expr:
sum by (device, ifname, pod_namespace, pod_name) (
  irate(unifabric_port_rcv_data{pod_namespace=~"$namespace", pod_name=~"$pod", cluster=~"${cluster:raw}"}[$__rate_interval])
)
/
sum by (device, ifname, pod_namespace, pod_name) (
  unifabric_port_speed_mbps{pod_namespace=~"$namespace", pod_name=~"$pod", cluster=~"${cluster:raw}"} * 1000000 / 8
) * 100

sum by (device, ifname, pod_namespace, pod_name) (
  irate(unifabric_port_xmit_data{pod_namespace=~"$namespace", pod_name=~"$pod", cluster=~"${cluster:raw}"}[$__rate_interval])
)
/
sum by (device, ifname, pod_namespace, pod_name) (
  unifabric_port_speed_mbps{pod_namespace=~"$namespace", pod_name=~"$pod", cluster=~"${cluster:raw}"} * 1000000 / 8
) * 100

panels.description: Number of received WRITE requests for the associated Queue Pairs
panels.title: RX Write Requests
Cumulative sends
panels.description: Total submissions in the time range, the sum of count in aggregation mode.

panels.title: Cumulative bytes sent
panels.description: Total payload bytes in the time range, bytes times count.

panels.title: Active QPs
panels.description: Current active QPs attributed to the selected source Pod.

panels.title: Peer Pods in time range
panels.description: Distinct peer Pods receiving sends from this Pod during the selected time range.

panels.title: Cumulative bytes from source Pod to destination Pods
panels.description: Cumulative bytes sent from the selected source Pod to each destination Pod. The legend includes destination WorkloadKind, WorkloadNS, PodNS, and PodName.

targets.expr: sum by (src_pod_namespace, src_pod_name, dst_pod_top_owner_kind, dst_pod_top_owner_namespace, dst_pod_namespace, dst_pod_name) (rdma_flow_bytes_total{cluster=~"${cluster:raw}", src_pod_namespace=~"$namespace", src_pod_name=~"$pod"})

panels.title: NIC cumulative transmit
panels.description: Cumulative bytes transmitted by each RDMA NIC counter for this Pod during the selected time range, for comparison with eBPF payload bytes.

panels.title: NIC cumulative receive
panels.description: Cumulative bytes received by each RDMA NIC counter for this Pod during the selected time range, for context alongside the eBPF send-side data.

panels.title: Top 20 most common message sizes
panels.description: Exact bytes values ordered by sends. LLM communication repeats a few message sizes, this shows which sizes are used and their share.

panels.title: Cumulative sends and size percentiles by source and destination Pod
panels.description: Prometheus-based cumulative sends, bytes, and message-size P50/P90/P99 for each source/destination Pod pair in the selected time range.

targets.expr: sum by (src_pod_namespace, src_pod_name, dst_pod_top_owner_kind, dst_pod_top_owner_namespace, dst_pod_namespace, dst_pod_name) (increase(rdma_flow_sends_total{cluster=~"${cluster:raw}", src_pod_namespace=~"$namespace", src_pod_name=~"$pod"}[$__range]))

sum by (src_pod_namespace, src_pod_name, dst_pod_top_owner_kind, dst_pod_top_owner_namespace, dst_pod_namespace, dst_pod_name) (increase(rdma_flow_bytes_total{cluster=~"${cluster:raw}", src_pod_namespace=~"$namespace", src_pod_name=~"$pod"}[$__range]))

histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le, src_pod_namespace, src_pod_name, dst_pod_top_owner_kind, dst_pod_top_owner_namespace, dst_pod_namespace, dst_pod_name) (increase(rdma_flow_send_bytes_bucket{cluster=~"${cluster:raw}", src_pod_namespace=~"$namespace", src_pod_name=~"$pod"}[$__range])))

histogram_quantile(0.90, sum by (le, src_pod_namespace, src_pod_name, dst_pod_top_owner_kind, dst_pod_top_owner_namespace, dst_pod_namespace, dst_pod_name) (increase(rdma_flow_send_bytes_bucket{cluster=~"${cluster:raw}", src_pod_namespace=~"$namespace", src_pod_name=~"$pod"}[$__range])))

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, src_pod_namespace, src_pod_name, dst_pod_top_owner_kind, dst_pod_top_owner_namespace, dst_pod_namespace, dst_pod_name) (increase(rdma_flow_send_bytes_bucket{cluster=~"${cluster:raw}", src_pod_namespace=~"$namespace", src_pod_name=~"$pod"}[$__range])))

matcher.options: ^(Cumulative bytes|P50 message size|P90 message size|P99 message size)$
